title: Project skeleton and AGENTS.md
lead: Create the Python package, test harness and agent/contributor guide.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** Flask, config, database or any feature code.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: There is no code yet. Every later slice needs an importable package, a test command that works, and an AGENTS.md that states the project's rules (stdlib-first, ask before adding dependencies, no commits unless asked).

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None beyond the tooling interview. The license is decided (AGPL-3.0; `LICENSE` already exists).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `pyproject.toml` (stdlib-friendly metadata; build backend per ADR 0017)
- `src/larder/__init__.py` (version)
- `tests/test_smoke.py`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `.gitignore` (exists; extend if the tooling adds caches)
- `pyproject.toml` license field: `AGPL-3.0-only`
- `README.md` (development section)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Create the package and test layout chosen in ADR 0017.
2. Write the smoke test; see it fail, then add `__version__`.
3. Write AGENTS.md: project summary, test/lint commands, dependency policy (ask first; stdlib-first; Flask is the only approved runtime dependency), secrets policy, the rule that household-specific data goes only in the gitignored `local/` folder, links to `docs/`, and slicer usage.
4. Set the license metadata to `AGPL-3.0-only`; add SPDX headers to source files if ADR 0017 says so.
5. Add a development quick start to README.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The test command from ADR 0017 passes.
- `python -c "import larder"` works from a fresh venv after install.
- `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
